```{r, include=FALSE}
library(readr)
library(sf)
library(flextable)
library(officer)
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(scales)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggspatial)
```

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
my_wd_all_dat <- "project_dir"

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(my_wd_all_dat))
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# Data observed densification
data_raw <- st_read("./data_prep_output/parcels_predictors_05_final.gpkg")

# Data prediction
pred_fin_parcel <- st_read("./data_model_and_prediction_pipeline/scenarios_parcellevel_all_parceltypes.gpkg")
```

## 1) Table observed densification
This is the number of parcels in the final dataset by structure type:

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
table_all_13 <- 
  data_raw %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  group_by(dep_dens) %>% 
    summarise(n_par = n(),
              dif_fa_sum = sum(dif_fa),
              fa_13_sum = sum(fa_13)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = dep_dens, values_from = n_par:fa_13_sum) %>% 
  mutate(n_par_total = n_par_densification + n_par_nochange, 
         n_perc_dens = round(n_par_densification / n_par_total*100, 1),
         fa_13_total = fa_13_sum_densification + fa_13_sum_nochange, 
         dif_fa_perc_dens = round(dif_fa_sum_densification / fa_13_total*100, 1),
         dif_fa_per_par = round(dif_fa_sum_densification/n_par_densification, 0),
         parceltype = "all") 

table_parceltype_13 <- 
  data_raw %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  group_by(parceltype, dep_dens) %>% 
    summarise(n_par = n(),
              dif_fa_sum = round(sum(dif_fa), 0),
              fa_13_sum = sum(fa_13)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = dep_dens, values_from = n_par:fa_13_sum) %>% 
  mutate(n_par_total = n_par_densification + n_par_nochange, 
         n_perc_dens = round(n_par_densification / n_par_total*100, 1),
         fa_13_total = fa_13_sum_densification + fa_13_sum_nochange, 
         dif_fa_perc_dens = round(dif_fa_sum_densification / fa_13_total*100, 1),
         dif_fa_per_par = round(dif_fa_sum_densification/n_par_densification, 0)) %>% 
  bind_rows(table_all_13)

table_parceltype_13$parceltype <- ordered(table_parceltype_13$parceltype, 
                                       levels = c("bu_res_sfh", "bu_res_mfh", "bu_nonres", "nbu", "all"))

kable(table_parceltype_13 %>% 
        arrange(parceltype) %>% 
        select(parceltype, n_par_total, n_par_densification, n_perc_dens, dif_fa_sum_densification,  dif_fa_perc_dens, dif_fa_per_par), 
      format.args = list(decimal.mark = '.', big.mark = ","))
```

```{r}
out_path <- "./output_maps/table_odd_2013.docx"

if (file.exists(out_path)) {
  file.remove(out_path)
}

tb <- table_parceltype_13 %>% 
                               arrange(parceltype) %>% 
                       select(parceltype, n_par_total, n_par_densification, n_perc_dens, dif_fa_sum_densification,  dif_fa_perc_dens, dif_fa_per_par)

ft <- flextable(tb)

ft <- ft %>%
  font(fontname = "Calibri", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") %>%
  width(width = 16 / ncol(tb), unit = "cm") %>%   # distribute total width across columns
  set_table_properties(layout = "fixed")

doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft)

print(doc, target = out_path)
```

## 2) Table prediction results densification

```{r, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

table_all <- 
  pred_fin_parcel %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  mutate(bs_scenario = if_else(is.na(bs_scenario), "nochange", "densification")) %>% 
  group_by(bs_scenario) %>% 
    summarise(n_par = n(),
              dif_fa_sum = round(sum(dif_fa_absolut_predicted), 0),
              fa_23_sum = sum(fa_23)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = bs_scenario, values_from = n_par:fa_23_sum) %>% 
  mutate(n_par_total = n_par_densification + n_par_nochange, 
         n_perc_dens = round(n_par_densification / n_par_total*100, 1),
         fa_23_total = fa_23_sum_densification + fa_23_sum_nochange, 
         dif_fa_perc_dens = round(dif_fa_sum_densification / fa_23_total*100, 1),
         dif_fa_per_par = round(dif_fa_sum_densification/n_par_densification, 0))

table_parceltype <- 
  pred_fin_parcel %>% 
  st_drop_geometry() %>% 
  mutate(bs_scenario = if_else(is.na(bs_scenario), "nochange", "densification")) %>% 
  group_by(parceltype, bs_scenario) %>% 
    summarise(n_par = n(),
              dif_fa_sum = round(sum(dif_fa_absolut_predicted), 0),
              fa_23_sum = sum(fa_23)) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = bs_scenario, values_from = n_par:fa_23_sum) %>% 
  mutate(n_par_total = n_par_densification + n_par_nochange, 
         n_perc_dens = round(n_par_densification / n_par_total*100, 1),
         fa_23_total = fa_23_sum_densification + fa_23_sum_nochange, 
         dif_fa_perc_dens = round(dif_fa_sum_densification / fa_23_total*100, 1),
         dif_fa_per_par = round(dif_fa_sum_densification/n_par_densification, 0)) %>% 
  bind_rows(table_all)

table_parceltype$parceltype <- ordered(table_parceltype$parceltype, 
                                       levels = c("bu_res_sfh", "bu_res_mfh", "bu_nonres", "nbu", "all"))

kable(table_parceltype %>% 
                arrange(parceltype) %>% 
        select(parceltype, n_par_total, n_par_densification, n_perc_dens, 
               dif_fa_sum_densification,  
               dif_fa_perc_dens, 
               dif_fa_per_par), 
      format.args = list(decimal.mark = '.', big.mark = ","))
```

```{r}
out_path <- "./output_maps/table_prediction_odd_2023.docx"

if (file.exists(out_path)) {
  file.remove(out_path)
}

tb_pred <- table_parceltype %>% 
                       arrange(parceltype) %>% 
                       select(parceltype, n_par_total, n_par_densification, n_perc_dens, 
                              dif_fa_sum_densification, 
                              dif_fa_perc_dens,
                              dif_fa_per_par)

ft_pred <- flextable(tb_pred)

ft_pred <- ft_pred %>%
  font(fontname = "Calibri", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") %>%
  width(width = 16 / ncol(tb_pred), unit = "cm") %>%   # distribute total width across columns
  set_table_properties(layout = "fixed")

doc <- read_docx() %>%
  body_add_flextable(ft_pred)

print(doc, target = out_path)
```
